# WaterfallChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWaterfallChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasWaterfallChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasWaterfallChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasWaterfallChart.h"`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWaterfallChartElement> CreateWaterfallChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWaterfallChartElement> CreateWaterfallChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<WaterfallChartDataVector> data, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasWaterfallChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
